profile.name: Aryan Vasudevan
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.bio: Hey! I'm Aryan, a software engineer based in Toronto with a love for building literally EVERYTHING. I'm also studying Computer Science at the University of Waterloo. Let's play badminton sometime!

experience.description: Built Linear feature requests and quality-of-life improvements for a platform serving 1M+ developers. Worked with TypeScript, Docker, and Node.js to redesign confusing self-serve pages, add search and filtering, and ship production code via GitHub Actions. Developed internal support tools, including a responsive TypeScript app mapping Roboflow's architecture to help onboard new support members. Provided assistance to individual and enterprise customers (up to $30k MRR) from user error to server-side issues while using Google Cloud Platform, Firebase, and network logs.

Drove user growth initiatives through hands-on testing, content creation, and technical documentation. Authored 12+ comprehensive project guides reaching 30,000+ users. Built app templates for RF-DETR models and developed YOLOv13 notebooks with Google Colab compatibility.
Oversaw full-stack development of the IgnitionHacks website, and hacker portal.

Organized and judged at one of Canada's largest recurring university hackathons with 500+ annual participants. Evaluated projects for Roboflow Computer Vision prize track and provided technical mentorship to participants.
Taught web development fundamentals including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Instructed Python programming concepts and introduced visual programming with Scratch to younger students.

projects.title: AutoClose
projects.elaboration: I got tired of people not closing my door when I asked : /—It's an ESP32 microcontroller connected to a piston that automatically closes the door when it detects that it's open. It's using an iOS app and a CoreML vision model trained with Roboflow.

projects.title: LogiCraft
projects.elaboration: Hackathon winner! Kids love Minecraft (me too), so why not teach them coding through it? This mod is hands-on and fun, teaching bitwise operation and logics with Minecraft redstone.

projects.title: Eye Spy
projects.elaboration: Losing your glasses is the worst. This app uses ARKit and a CoreML model on an iOS app to help you find your glasses by scanning your surroundings with your phone's camera.

projects.title: DetectionSmoother
projects.elaboration: During my internship at Roboflow, I built an open-source tool for smoothing object detection results to create more polished demos and presentations.
